issues.name: glfw-mixin-loaded-too-early
issues.description: GLFWMixin fails to apply because its target (org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW, or org.lwjgl.sdl.SDLEvents on 26.3+) is loaded too early under the LabyMod class loader, crashing during mixin prepare (MixinTargetAlreadyLoadedException). Fixed by retargeting the mixin to the poll call in Minecraft's pollEvents
